idea-plugin.name: Generative Prompt Selection Plugin
idea-plugin.description:
Generative Prompt Selection Plugin (GPS Plugin)

This plugin provides a convenient way to access and use pre-defined prompts for Android development, especially for Jetpack Compose and Material 3 design patterns.

Features:

  • 📋 Pre-defined prompts for Android development
  • 🎨 Jetpack Compose UI component prompts
  • 🔍 Search and filter functionality
  • 📱 Material 3 design guidelines
  • 📋 One-click copy to clipboard

Usage:

Open the "GPS Prompts" tool window on the right side of Android Studio to browse and copy prompts.
